description:
Huawei #DigitALLNight2026 brought together over a thousand students in Florence and participating locations across Europe to discover #Huawei's latest innovations and explore exciting career opportunities in STEM and ICT.
 
DigitALL Night is Huawei's flagship annual talent event, connecting students and young professionals with cutting-edge technologies, industry insights, and diverse career pathways. The event took place at HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 • FLORENCE.
 
Ready to take the next step in your career? Explore new opportunities at Huawei: https://bit.ly/488voos #HUAWEICONNECT #HuaweiNews
